description.value: Kyros Kitchen is a fast-casual Mediterranean restaurant on UBC's campus serving spinning shawarma, grilled kebabs, homestyle stews, and a build-your-own pasta station. The concept emphasizes speed alongside quality, making it a practical refueling stop for cyclists passing through the UBC area. Located in unit 1302 of a larger campus building, it draws students and professionals alike with its fresh, made-daily menu.
